summary: King's Rest requires essentially complete enemy-forces coverage, strong interrupt and purge assignments, and precise add control across all four bosses.
actions: Plan to defeat every required enemy because the current route has no meaningful trash-count skip allowance.
Prioritize Hex Volley, Bind Soul, Unholy Mending, Wretched Discharge, Hex, Poison Nova, and Deathly Roar interrupts.
Purge Minions of Zul to destroy them quickly, remove dangerous enemy buffs, and kill Healing Tide Totems immediately.
Prevent Animated Gold from reaching the Golden Serpent; free Entombed players promptly on Mchimba.
Kill explosive totems during the Council and move immediately when Dazar begins Gilded Destruction so spears are placed safely.

provenance.description: Original compact strategy summary derived from targeted review of Wowhead's Patch 12.1 dungeon overview.
